content: it would be useful if the list of parts was sorted by bag i keep picking up bags twice

Before assembling this, check that the C1 Front profile is not bent. I noticed that mine had slight curve on upper part on the edge of big opening, where the vertical side bends ends (viewing from the side). This might affect slightly to your dock calibration as it did mine. The plate itself is semi-bendable by hand, so be careful when assembling.

This is a good place to remove the white LED strip from the metal bar and apply it to this front profile panel. If you apply it to the back side where the Prusa INDX label is, it will be at the same height as before. If you follow the instructions, it ends up being too low to be of any practical use.
My bag for the big springs bag was missing the "0/5" part in the "0.5x8.5x30"
